evals.name: whats-next
evals.expected_output: A one-screen answer: work blocked on the user first (unmerged worktrees, open PRs), then in-flight specs per client with a reason each counts as live, then a per-client backlog count rather than an enumeration, ending in exactly one recommended next action. Must not list all ~57 stale buildable specs and must not read queue.json.

assertions.text: Does not read or cite queue.json, which is deprecated
Does not list the ~57 stale buildable specs individually; reports them as a per-client count
Ends with exactly one recommended next action, not a menu of options
Surfaces work blocked on the user (unmerged worktrees / open PRs) before the spec backlog
States why each in-flight spec counts as live (recent commit, live branch, or recent edit)
Answer is one screen — under 60 lines of output

evals.name: reorient-after-break
evals.prompt: just got back from a few days off, where are we on everything?
evals.expected_output: Same structure, oriented to someone with no recent context: covers every client that has live work, names what changed recently, and still ends with a single concrete recommendation rather than a menu.

assertions.text: Covers the clients that actually have live work rather than only one
Names concrete recent activity (specific commits, branches or specs) rather than a vague summary
Reports the stale backlog as counts, not an enumeration
Ends with a single concrete recommendation rather than handing back a menu
Answer is one screen — under 60 lines of output

evals.name: worktree-merge-debt
evals.prompt: what have i got sitting in worktrees that needs merging?
evals.expected_output: Accurate per-worktree report: branch, unmerged commit count, dirty state. Must correctly identify the worktrees with unmerged commits and flag any fully-merged clean worktree as safe to remove via /tidy. Must not claim to have merged anything.

assertions.text: Identifies all five worktrees carrying unmerged commits: carsa-code-migration-cdn-revision, jayshetty-beehiiv-investigation, meta-analysis-automation, tamsen-kp-checklist, triage-inbox-cleanup
Reports accurate unmerged commit counts (tamsen-kp-checklist=3, triage-inbox-cleanup=2, the other three=1 each)
Flags worktree-tidy-cmm-purge-step as fully merged and clean, therefore safe to remove
Does not claim to have merged, pushed or deleted anything
Answer is one screen — under 60 lines of output
